profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I love writing code.  There is nothing quite like the rush of solving and writing complicated logic that brings your creations to life.  It is an incredibly rewarding experience!

positions.title: Psychiatric Technician
positions.description: Duties included observation of patients’ attitudes and behaviors and overseeing short therapeutic group sessions. Verbal deescalation techniques utilizing strong interpersonal skills were used to keep the unit and all patients safe. Office skills were also needed for managing healthcare documents.

positions.title: Third Key
positions.description: Duties included payroll calculation, staff scheduling, inventory processing, and general management. Handled customer complaints and employee issues. Duties also involved end of day processing including depositing money with the bank.

honors.title: 2017 IVRC Immersathon Winner
honors.description: Part of the winning team for the 2017 IVRC Immersathon!
honors.issuer: Issued by Idaho Virtual Reality Council · Mar 2017
